title: Every recovered craft gets a reverse-engineered copy

tellings.quote: From my understanding, from what's been relayed to me was that every craft that they recover, they also make reverse engineered versions of trying to replicate that technology or that specific craft.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest named Michael Herrera passes on something he says was told to him by others. According to what was relayed to him, every craft that is recovered also gets copies built from it, made by taking the original apart and studying it, in an attempt to copy that technology or that particular craft. If true, it would mean a hidden effort to rebuild machines that did not come from people.
